Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}", "{\"captioning\":{\"llm\":{\"max_concurrency\":2,\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"},\"min_image_area\":1000},\"concurrency\":{\"max_threads\":8}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].mimeType())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
```
